intent: Small identity atom that shows a user or workspace as initials, photo, org icon, or a +N overflow badge, with optional multiplayer presence status.

slots.icon: Org/workspace icon (ReactNode) rendered centered in place of initials or photo.

font.note: weight and tracking are hardcoded arbitrary values

size.note: px and text/leading are hardcoded Tailwind arbitrary values

tokens.note: Identity colors (AVATAR_COLORS: #9747ff/#007be5/#ff24bd/#f24822/#ffcd29/#14ae5c/#b3b3b3/#18a0fb), overflow-read grey #b3b3b3, and AvatarStatus colors (#ffcd29 dash/rings, #14ae5c audio bars, white outlines) are fixed hex literals — intentionally not mode-adaptive.

a11y.role: none — presentational <div>; not focusable or interactive
a11y.image: photo variant renders (decorative); host must convey identity via adjacent text or an aria-label on the wrapping control
a11y.text: initials and overflow count are visible text only, not labelled for assistive tech
a11y.status: AvatarStatus indicators are pointer-events-none decoration, not exposed to assistive tech
